data/2/entries/2/entries/7/entries/1/ent.english: The treasure lies in a crypt in Castle Ravenloft ({@adventure chapter 4|CoS|5}, area K84, {@area crypt 31|2fb|x}).
data/2/entries/2/entries/7/entries/1/ent.zh_tw: 寶物位於鴉閣城堡的一間墓室內（{@adventure 第4章|CoS|5}，區域 K84，{@area 第31號墓室|2fb|x}）。

data/2/entries/2/entries/7/entries/1/ent.english: The treasure lies in the crypt of General Kroval "Mad Dog" Grislek ({@adventure chapter 4|CoS|5}, area K84, {@area crypt 38|30f|x}).
data/2/entries/2/entries/7/entries/1/ent.zh_tw: 寶物位於柯洛瓦「瘋狗」格里斯雷克將軍的墓室內（{@adventure 第4章|CoS|5}，區域 K84，{@area 第38號墓室|30f|x}）。

data/2/entries/2/entries/7/entries/2/ent.english: The treasure is hidden in the crypt of Gralmore Nimblenobs ({@adventure chapter 4|CoS|5}, area K84, {@area crypt 37|30b|x}).
data/2/entries/2/entries/7/entries/2/ent.zh_tw: 寶物藏在格拉爾莫·敏思的墓室內（{@adventure 第4章|CoS|5}，區域 K84，{@area 第37號墓室|30b|x}）。

data/14/entries/8/entries/17/entries/1.english: The cracks in the floor were made by the golem in {@area area X10|5f3|x}. The arrow slits are 5 inches wide, 2½ feet tall, and 1 foot thick. They look down on the temple ({@area area X5|5df|x}).
data/14/entries/8/entries/17/entries/1.zh_tw: 地板上的裂痕是{@area 區域 X10|5f3|x}的魔像造成的。箭孔寬5吋、高2½尺、厚1尺，從中可以俯瞰神殿（{@area 區域 X5|5df|x}）。

data/1/entries/0.english: Under raging storm clouds, a lone figure stands silhouetted against the ancient walls of Castle Ravenloft. The vampire Count {@creature Strahd von Zarovich|CoS} stares down a sheer cliff at the village below. A cold, bitter wind spins dead leaves about him, billowing his cape in the darkness.
data/1/entries/0.zh_tw: 狂怒的風暴雲下，一道孤獨的身影矗立在鴉閣城堡的古老城牆前。吸血鬼伯爵{@creature Strahd von Zarovich|CoS|施特拉德·馮·扎洛維奇}從陡峭的絕壁上俯視巴洛維亞村。寒風呼嘯，捲起枯葉在他身旁打轉。他的披風在黑暗中獵獵翻飛。

data/0/entries/0/entries/0/entries/4.english: I remember thinking at the time, What are {@i you} doing here? This creature seemed completely out of place with the kobolds, orcs, and gelatinous cubes we had seen thus far. This was a creature who deserved his own setting and to be so much more than just a wandering monster. When I came home from that game, I told all these thoughts to Laura.
data/0/entries/0/entries/0/entries/4.zh_tw: 我記得自己當時在想：{@i 你}怎麼會出現在這裡？和我們此前遇過的狗頭人、獸人、膠質方塊相比，這個生物顯得格格不入。牠值得擁有自己的舞臺，遠不該只是個遊蕩怪物。那次遊戲結束回家後，我把這些想法全都告訴了勞拉。

data/1/entries/4/entries/1/entries/0.english: This adventure is a retelling of the original {@i Ravenloft} adventure, which was published in 1983 by TSR, Inc. In the years since, the original has gained a reputation as one of the greatest {@b Dungeons & Dragons} adventures ever, and it went on to inspire the creation of a campaign setting of the same name in 1990: Ravenloft, home of the Domains of Dread.
data/1/entries/4/entries/1/entries/0.zh_tw: 本冒險重新演繹了TSR公司於1983年出版的原版{@i 鴉閣魔域}冒險。多年來，原作被譽為有史以來最出色的{@b 龍與地下城}冒險之一，並啟發了1990年同名戰役設定的誕生：鴉閣魔域，恐懼領域的所在之地。

data/1/entries/4/entries/7/entries/0.english: Much of the adventure's action is driven by the clash between the adventurers' decisions and Strahd's goals, and the adventurers and the vampire are all caught in strands of fate that are represented by a special card reading detailed in {@area chapter 1|021|x}, "Into the Mists." Before you run the adventure, you need to conduct that reading to determine the location of several items that are key to the story, as well as one of the locations where Strahd can be found.
data/1/entries/4/entries/7/entries/0.zh_tw: 這場冒險中的許多事件，都由冒險者的決定與施特拉德的目標之間的衝突所推動。冒險者與這名吸血鬼同樣困在命運之網中；這些命運由一次特殊的卡牌占卜呈現，詳見{@area 第1章|021|x}「踏入迷霧」。主持冒險之前，你必須先進行這次占卜，決定幾件劇情關鍵物品的位置，以及其中一處能找到施特拉德的地點。

data/2/entries/0.english: Eerie mists surround Barovia and bind its inhabitants there. This chapter gives you the information you need to prepare for the adventurers' journey into those mists. The chapter first outlines the history and goals of Count {@creature Strahd von Zarovich|CoS} so that you are prepared for what awaits the characters. In the "{@area Fortunes of Ravenloft|01d|x}" section, the chapter walks you through the tarokka card reading that helps set the stage for the adventure's action, and the chapter closes with adventure hooks that you can use to draw the characters into the horror of Barovia.
data/2/entries/0.zh_tw: 詭異的迷霧環繞巴洛維亞，也將居民囚禁於此。本章提供冒險者深入迷霧之前所需的準備資訊。首先概述{@creature Strahd von Zarovich|CoS|施特拉德·馮·扎洛維奇}伯爵的歷史與目標，讓你準備好迎接角色們將面對的一切。「{@area 魔域天機|01d|x}」一節會帶你進行塔羅卡牌占卜，為冒險中的事件布置舞臺；本章最後則提供冒險契機，讓你將角色引入巴洛維亞的恐怖之中。

data/2/entries/2/entries/5/entries/1/ent.english: Hearts = Glyphs Diamonds = Coins Spades = Swords Clubs = Stars
data/2/entries/2/entries/5/entries/1/ent.zh_tw: 紅心＝雕紋；方塊＝硬幣；黑桃＝寶劍；梅花＝星星

data/3/entries/14/entries/10/entries/0/e.english: Even here, in the mountains, the forest and the fog are inescapable. Ahead, the dirt road splits in two, widening toward the east. There you see patches of cobblestone, suggesting that the eastern branch was once an important thoroughfare.
data/3/entries/14/entries/10/entries/0/e.zh_tw: 即使來到山間，你們仍無法擺脫森林與迷霧。前方的土路一分為二，通往東方的岔路逐漸變寬。那裡仍看得見一片片鵝卵石鋪面，顯示東邊的岔路曾是一條重要通道。

data/6/entries/6/entries/2/entries/6/ent.english: If the characters earn the trust of the wereravens in Vallaki, the Keepers of the Feather will watch their backs. The next time the characters get themselves in serious trouble, you can have a group of {@dice 1d4} {@creature Wereraven|VRGR|wereravens} show up to rescue or otherwise help them.
data/6/entries/6/entries/2/entries/6/ent.zh_tw: 如果角色們贏得瓦拉吉鴉人的信任，羽衛就會在暗中照應他們。下次角色們陷入重大危機時，你可以安排{@dice 1d4}名{@creature Wereraven|VRGR|鴉人}現身救援，或以其他方式協助他們。

data/8/entries/7/entries/6/entries/0.english: A {@creature revenant}, as described in the {@book Monster Manual|MM}, has a year to achieve its revenge before its body crumbles to dust and its soul enters the afterlife. In Barovia, however, a revenant can remain in its body indefinitely, and once it has reaped its vengeance, its soul remains trapped in Barovia.
data/8/entries/7/entries/6/entries/0.zh_tw: 如{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}所述，{@creature revenant||還魂鬼}只有一年的時間完成復仇，隨後其身體就會化為塵土，靈魂則進入來世。然而，在巴洛維亞，還魂鬼可以無限期地留在自己的身體中；即使完成復仇，其靈魂仍會困在巴洛維亞。

data/9/entries/5/entries/12.english: The windows of the north wing are made of leaded glass that is translucent—good for letting in light but not good for seeing through. The windows of the east wing are broken outward and have damaged shutters.
data/9/entries/5/entries/12.zh_tw: 北翼的窗戶是以鉛條鑲嵌的半透明玻璃，能讓光線透入，卻看不清窗外。東翼的窗戶向外破裂，百葉窗也已損壞。

data/13/entries/13/entries/3/entries/0.english: A light drizzle begins to fall. Unpainted fences blindly follow the trail, which skirts north of a sprawling vineyard before bending south toward a stately building. The fog takes on ghostly forms as it swirls between the neatly tended rows of grapevines. Here and there, you see rope-handled half-barrels used for hauling grapes. North of the trail is a large stand of trees. A man wearing a dark cloak and cowl stands at the edge of the trees, beckoning you.
data/13/entries/13/entries/3/entries/0.zh_tw: 細雨開始飄落。未上漆的柵欄沿著小徑一路延伸；小徑繞過大片葡萄園的北側，再向南轉往一棟氣派的建築。霧氣在照料整齊的一列列葡萄藤之間翻湧，幻化出鬼魅般的形影。各處散放著用來搬運葡萄的半截木桶，桶上裝著繩索提把。小徑北方有一大片樹叢，一名身穿深色斗篷、戴著兜帽的男子站在樹邊，向你們招手。

data/22/entries/1.english: Although the workmanship and artistic quality of the cards can vary from deck to deck, the ability of the cards to call forth information about the future is far more valuable than the monetary worth of a deck.
data/22/entries/1.zh_tw: 雖然每副牌的製作工藝與藝術品質不盡相同，牌組揭示未來資訊的能力，卻遠比它本身的金錢價值珍貴。

data/22/entries/3/entries/1.english: Each suit contains cards numbered one through nine, plus a tenth card that is called the master of that suit. A card can be referred to by its suit designation or by its name. For instance, the three of glyphs is also known as the {@card healer|Tarokka Deck|CoS}, and the {@card wizard|Tarokka Deck|CoS} card is also known as the master of stars.
data/22/entries/3/entries/1.zh_tw: 每種花色都有編號1至9的牌，以及第10張稱為該花色「主牌」的牌。每張牌都可以用花色與編號，或用牌名來稱呼。例如，雕紋3也稱為{@card healer|Tarokka Deck|CoS|醫療師}，而{@card wizard|Tarokka Deck|CoS|法師}牌也稱為星星主牌。

data/3/entries/12/entries/5/entries/3.english: When it comes to sharing information about their dark master, Strahd's Vistani pretend to be helpful, but the information they impart is misleading at best and often deceptive. They readily tell adventurers that they have a potion that protects them from the deadly fog that surrounds Barovia. Although this is a lie, they attempt to sell their fake potion for as much money as they can get.
data/3/entries/12/entries/5/entries/3.zh_tw: 當涉及到分享關於他們黑暗主人的資訊時，施特拉德的維斯塔尼人假裝樂於助人，但他們所提供的資訊充其量是誤導性的，而且往往是欺騙性的。他們輕易地告訴冒險者們，他們有一種藥水可以保護他們免受巴洛維亞周圍致命迷霧的侵害。儘管這是個謊言，他們仍試圖以儘可能高的價格出售他們的假藥水。
data/3/entries/12/entries/5/entries/3.reason: master 指維斯塔尼人效忠的施特拉德。

data/5/entries/11/entries/6/entries/3/en.reason: 傳送詩句指施特拉德的新娘。
傳送詩句指施特拉德的墓穴。

data/5/entries/11/entries/13/entries/49/.english: {@i General Kroval "Mad Dog" Grislek (Master of the Hunt): A leader of hounds and men}
data/5/entries/11/entries/13/entries/49/.zh_tw: {@i 格里斯雷克將軍"瘋狗"（狩獵統領）：獵犬與人的首領}
data/5/entries/11/entries/13/entries/49/.reason: Master of the Hunt 為率領獵犬及人員的職銜。

data/6/entries/6/entries/3/entries/14/en.english: The burgomaster's monstrous henchman, {@creature Izek Strazni|CoS} (see {@area appendix D|77c|x}), sleeps here at night. During the day, he is in town taking care of his master's business. Izek's chest is unlocked and contains a heap of wrinkled clothes, under which is a nonmagical shortsword.
data/6/entries/6/entries/3/entries/14/en.zh_tw: 鎮長的怪物親信，{@creature Izek Strazni|CoS|艾澤克·施特拉茲尼}（見{@area 附錄D|77c|x}），在黑夜中睡在這裡。白晝時，他在小鎮中替主人辦事。艾澤克的箱子沒有上鎖，裡面有一堆皺巴巴的衣服，衣服下面是一把非魔法的短劍。
data/6/entries/6/entries/3/entries/14/en.reason: 艾澤克是鎮長的親信，非學徒。

data/15/entries/1.english: The druids who worship Strahd as lord of the land and master of the weather convene here, atop Yester Hill, on the very edge of Strahd's domain. This hill is also where the evil blights that walk the Svalich Woods are born, and where Strahd comes on occasion to glimpse his ancestral home.
data/15/entries/1.zh_tw: 崇拜施特拉德為大地之主與天候的掌控者的德魯伊們聚集於此，在施特拉德領地邊緣的往日山丘之上。這座丘陵也是遊蕩於斯瓦里奇森林的邪惡枯萎怪們的誕生之地，施特拉德偶爾會來此瞥見他的祖居。
data/15/entries/1.reason: master of the weather 指對天候的支配。

data/17/entries/3/entries/3/entries/1/en.english: "Master!" says a voice from behind you. An elf with dusky brown skin and long black hair, his face a mask of terror, looks on what you have wrought and screams.
data/17/entries/3/entries/3/entries/1/en.zh_tw: "主人！"一個聲音從你身後傳來。一個有著深褐色皮膚和黑色長髮的精靈，滿臉驚恐，看著你所造成的景象並尖叫起來。
data/17/entries/3/entries/3/entries/1/en.reason: 拉哈丁呼喚自己侍奉的施特拉德。 mask of terror 是表情，非實體面具。

data/19/entries/4/entries/10/entries/3/e.reason: dread 修飾領主；master 是主從稱謂。

data/5/entries/6/entries/17/entries/2.english: The spiral staircase has no railing and connects the main floor of the castle with each level above it. First, the staircase climbs 50 feet to a landing (shown on {@adventure map 4|CoS|5|Map 4: Court of the Count}), from which an open archway leads to {@area area K13|1c1|x}. East of that opening is a secret door that conceals a ladder leading down to {@area area K34|1fd|x}.
data/5/entries/6/entries/17/entries/2.zh_tw: 螺旋樓梯沒有扶手，使城堡的主樓層與上方各樓層相通。首先，樓梯爬升50尺到達一個平臺（顯示在{@adventure 地圖 4|CoS|5|Map 4: Court of the Count}上），從那裡一個敞開的拱廊通往{@area 區域K13|1c1|x}。在那個開口的東邊是一扇暗門，隱藏著一個通往{@area 區域K34|1fd|x}的梯子。
data/5/entries/6/entries/17/entries/2.reason: level 指建築樓層。 避免通用繁化將建築的連接再換成網路語境的連線。

data/19/entries/4/entries/33/entries/1/e.english: Once the trapdoor has been found and opened, it remains available to characters as a way into and out of the dungeon level.
data/19/entries/4/entries/33/entries/1/e.zh_tw: 一旦找到並開啟活板門，它就會一直保持可用，讓角色們作為進出地牢層的通道。
data/19/entries/4/entries/33/entries/1/e.reason: dungeon level 指地牢樓層；保留 remains available。

data/5/entries/7/name.reason: Court 含接見廳、侍衛哨與侍從房，指宮廷而非露天庭院。

data/5/entries/7/entries/1/images/0/titl.reason: Court 含接見廳、侍衛哨與侍從房，指宮廷而非露天庭院。

data/5/entries/7/entries/2/images/0/titl.english: Court of the Count (Battlemap; DM Version)
data/5/entries/7/entries/2/images/0/titl.zh_tw: 伯爵的宮廷（戰鬥地圖；DM版）
data/5/entries/7/entries/2/images/0/titl.reason: Court 含接見廳、侍衛哨與侍從房，指宮廷而非露天庭院。

data/5/entries/7/entries/2/images/1/titl.english: Court of the Count (Battlemap; Player Version)
data/5/entries/7/entries/2/images/1/titl.zh_tw: 伯爵的宮廷（戰鬥地圖；玩家版本）
data/5/entries/7/entries/2/images/1/titl.reason: Court 含接見廳、侍衛哨與侍從房，指宮廷而非露天庭院。

data/22/entries/3/name.reason: Composition 下文解說54張牌的組成。

data/22/entries/5/entries/4/entries/0.english: This suit symbolizes faith, spirituality, and inner strength. It is the suit of priests and those who devote themselves to the service of a deity, a higher power, or a heightened philosophy. On the side of good, it represents willpower and dedication. On the side of evil, the suit signifies weakness of character, self-doubt, and betrayal of one's ideals or beliefs. It symbolizes health and healing, as well as illness and disease.
data/22/entries/5/entries/4/entries/0.zh_tw: 雕紋牌組象徵著信仰、靈性和內在力量。它是祭司們的牌組，也是那些致力於將人生奉獻給神性、超自然力或者某種崇高哲學的人的牌組。從好的方面來說,它體現了意志力和奉獻。從壞的方面來說，它代表著性格上的軟弱、自我懷疑、對理想和信仰的背叛。它同時也象徵著健康和治療、疾患與病痛。
data/22/entries/5/entries/4/entries/0.reason: weakness of character 是品性而非遊戲角色弱點。

data/8/entries/9/entries/37/entries/2.english: If the beacon has not been lit, the body is serving as a host for the revenant. If the characters approach it, it says, "Go away." If they don't leave immediately, read:
data/8/entries/9/entries/37/entries/2.zh_tw: 若信標還未點亮，這具身軀正作為還魂鬼的宿主。如果角色們靠近它，它會說：「快離開。」如果他們不立即離開，讀出：
data/8/entries/9/entries/37/entries/2.reason: host 指靈體寄居的身軀。

data/2/entries/3/entries/9/entries/0/ent.english: {@creature Stanimir|CoS}'s face becomes a somber mask. "A curse has befallen our noble prince, turning him into a tyrant. We alone have the power to leave his domain. We've traveled far and wide to find heroes such as yourselves to end our dread lord's curse and put his troubled soul to rest. Our leader, {@creature Madam Eva|CoS}, knows all. Will you return to Barovia with us and speak with her?"
data/2/entries/3/entries/9/entries/0/ent.zh_tw: {@creature Stanimir|CoS|斯塔尼米爾}的神情變得凝重。"一個詛咒降臨到我們高貴的王子身上了，將他變成了一位暴君。只有我們有能力離開他的領地。我們長途跋涉尋找像你們這樣的英雄來結束我們可畏的領主的詛咒，讓他飽受困擾的靈魂獲得安息。我們的首領，{@creature Madam Eva|CoS|伊娃夫人}，知道所有事情。你們願意隨我們回到巴洛維亞並與她交談嗎？"
data/2/entries/3/entries/9/entries/0/ent.reason: somber mask 描述表情。 dread lord 為可畏的領主而非恐懼之王專名。

data/5/entries/10/entries/4/entries/8.english: All creatures trapped inside the elevator (including {@condition unconscious} ones) must roll initiative. The compartment takes 1 round to reach the top of the shaft, stopping just beneath {@area area K47|225|x}. Each creature inside has one turn to act before the compartment comes to a dead stop. Their initiative rolls determine the order in which the occupants act. Conscious party members can take whatever actions they like. They might search for a way out, wake sleeping party members, cast spells, or take other actions. {@condition Unconscious} ones can do nothing.
data/5/entries/10/entries/4/entries/8.zh_tw: 所有被困在升降梯內的生物（包括{@condition unconscious||昏迷}者）必須擲先攻。轎廂需要一輪時間到達豎井頂部，停在{@area 區域K47|225|x}正下方。每個轎廂內的生物在轎廂完全停止前有一回合的行動時間。他們的先攻骰決定乘員行動的順序。清醒的隊員可以採取任意動作。他們可以搜尋出路、喚醒沉睡的隊員、施展法術或執行其他動作。{@condition Unconscious||昏迷}者則什麼都做不了。
data/5/entries/10/entries/4/entries/8.reason: 電梯 occupants 是乘員；initiative order 是行動順序。

data/8/entries/9/entries/37/entries/3/en.english: "If you have come to free this land from the creature that feasts on the blood of the innocent, know this: There is no monster I hate more than {@creature Strahd von Zarovich|CoS}. He slew Argynvost, broke the life of the knight I loved, and destroyed the valiant order to which I devoted my life, but Strahd has already died once. He can't be allowed to die again. Instead, he must suffer eternally in a hell of his own creation, from which he can never escape. Whatever can be done to bring him misery and unrest, I will do, but I will destroy anyone who tries to end his torment."
data/8/entries/9/entries/37/entries/3/en.zh_tw: "如果你來此是為了從嗜食無辜者鮮血的生物手中解放這片土地，應要知曉：沒有比{@creature Strahd von Zarovich|CoS|施特拉德·馮·扎洛維奇}更令我憎恨的怪物。他殺害了奧金弗斯特，奪走了我所愛騎士的生命，並摧毀了我畢生奉獻的英勇騎士團，但施特拉德已經死過一次。絕不能讓他再次死去。相反，他必須在他自己創造的、永世無法逃脫的地獄中承受永恆的痛苦。只要能給他帶來痛苦與不安，我都會去做，但我會摧毀任何試圖結束他折磨的人。"

data/8/entries/9/entries/38/entries/9/en.english: If your card reading reveals that Sir Godfrey is Strahd's enemy and the characters persuasively ask him for help, he offers to join the fight against the vampire. Fate has unlocked his memory of the love that he and Vladimir once shared, and the power of that memory drives Godfrey to help fight Strahd and restore the order's honor.
data/8/entries/9/entries/38/entries/9/en.zh_tw: 如果你的卡牌占卜揭示出高德弗裡爵士是施特拉德的敵人，且角色們有說服力地請求他協助，他會提出加入對抗吸血鬼的戰鬥。命運喚醒了他與弗拉基米爾曾經共享的愛的記憶，這記憶的力量驅使高德弗裡協助對抗施特拉德並重拾騎士團的榮譽。

data/8/entries/9/entries/54/entries/4/en.english: {@creature Vladimir Horngaard|CoS} and the other revenants that haunt Barovia see the light as a reminder of all that was once good and noble about the knightly order to which they once belonged. They let go of their hatred and their corporeal bodies, leaving corpses behind as their spirits find rest at long last. Henceforth, any random encounter with a revenant should be treated as no encounter.
data/8/entries/9/entries/54/entries/4/en.zh_tw: {@creature Vladimir Horngaard|CoS|弗拉基米爾·霍恩嘉德} 與其他作祟於巴洛維亞的還魂鬼們看見這光芒，彷彿在提醒著他們曾經所屬的騎士團中所有善良與高尚的事物。他們放下了仇恨與肉身，留下屍體，讓他們的精魂最終找到了安息。此後，任何與還魂鬼的隨機遭遇都應視為無遭遇。

data/23/entries/1/entries/0/entries/2.zh_tw: 敬邀你們的東道主，{@creature Strahd von Zarovich|CoS|施特拉德·馮·扎洛維奇}
data/23/entries/1/entries/0/entries/2.reason: host 是邀請賓客者，非收信者的主子。

data/1/entries/2.english: Rumbling thunder pounds the castle spires. The wind's howling increases as Strahd turns his gaze back to the village. Far below, yet not beyond his ken, a party of adventurers has just entered his domain. Strahd's face forms a twisted smile as his dark plan unfolds. He knew they were coming, and he knows why they have come—all according to his plan. He, the master of Ravenloft, will attend to them.
data/1/entries/2.zh_tw: 滾雷砸在城堡的塔尖上。風聲越發淒厲，施特拉德將視線轉回地上的村子。村子非常遠，但他依然看得清楚。一隊冒險者剛剛進入他的領地。隨著他那邪惡的計劃逐漸展開，施特拉德露出了扭曲的微笑。他知道這些人要來，也知道他們為何而來——這都是他一手策劃的。而他，鴉閣城堡的主人，將盛情"款待"他們。
data/1/entries/2.reason: why they have come 不是要求。 指冒險者。

data/3/entries/14/entries/14/entries/4.english: Believing that the characters aim to kill him, the Mad Mage unleashes his destructive magic. As he tears into them, he shouts, "You think my magic has grown weak? Think again!" If he is reduced to 50 hit points or fewer, he shouts, "Tell your dark masters they can break my body, but never my spirit!" He then tries to escape.
data/3/entries/14/entries/14/entries/4.zh_tw: 瘋法師認為角色們是來殺他的，於是釋放出他毀滅性的魔法。當他猛攻它們時，他喊道："你們以為我的魔法變弱了？再想想吧！"如果他的生命值被減少到50點或更少，他會喊道："告訴你們那些黑暗的主人，他們可以摧毀我的身體，但永遠無法擊垮我的意志！"然後他會試圖逃脫。
data/3/entries/14/entries/14/entries/4.reason: break my spirit 指意志不可屈服。
